title: Selection of the rehabilitation clinic by the insured. Description of the insured's decision-making process in the amended procedure of the right to choose a rehabilitation clinic according to § 15 SGB VI.
summary:
The aim of this study is to determine how rehabilitation patients choose their rehabilitation clinic. What decision criteria and strategies do they use?

The procedure, in place since 2023, has ensured that the option to choose is used very frequently. What are the benefits for individuals, the pension insurance provider, and the clinics?

These questions will be investigated through an interview study conducted in eight rehabilitation clinics. Participants' responses will be recorded and later transcribed. A specific method will be used to map the main areas of response to the research question. This will be the study's outcome. This will allow for the development of models that can be tested in future studies, including quantitative analysis. The resulting knowledge about selection strategies when rehabilitation is proposed can make the choice easier or better for the insured individuals themselves. Furthermore, the insights gained can demonstrate to clinics and pension insurance providers how to simplify the process and provide more targeted information to their rehabilitation patients.
conditions: Selection process of the appropriate rehabilitation clinic by the insured themselves according to § 15 SGB VI

interventions.name:
Study Design: Exploratory multicenter qualitative study
Time points: One-off survey, cross-sectional
Study Centers: Klinik Niederrhein, Bad Neuenahr, rehabilitation clinics (8), BAG-Selbsthilfe (German Association for Self-Help)
Patients: Rehabilitation patients during their inpatient rehabilitat

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Rehabilitation patients during their rehabilitation stay, whereby the following criteria should be met at least once across their entire spectrum:

Age
Gender
Educational level
Socioeconomic status
Indication
Mode of rehabilitation
Disability
Service provider
Exercise of the right to vote
Exclusion criteria:
none
